name: setup-duckdb-action
description: GitHub action that installs DuckDB with the version provided in input.

scripts.prepare: npm run build && ncc build build/index.js -o dist --source-map --license licenses.txt
scripts.test: tsc --ignoreConfig install-plan.ts tests/install-plan.test.ts --module commonjs --target ES2022 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node --outDir .test-build && node --test .test-build/tests/install-plan.test.js
scripts.all: npm run lint && npm run prepare
